area-1.name: Product documentation
area-1.ARP1.hint:
The product must have a visible, legible, and traceable identifier—like a model number, serial number, batch ID, or another unique reference. If it’s not technically feasible to place this directly on the product (due to size or design), the information must be clearly provided on the packaging or in the accompanying documentation. 



Documentation and traceability are key administrative requirements under the CRA that help regulators, partners, and customers verify that your product meets essential cybersecurity obligations. You are required to keep the product’s technical documentation and the EU Declaration of Conformity on file for at least 10 years after the product is placed on the market—or longer, if the declared support period is longer than 10 years. These documents must be made available to market surveillance authorities if requested.

In addition, you must provide users with either a full EU Declaration of Conformity or a simplified version that includes a direct link to the full version hosted online. This ensures that users, importers, and authorities can confirm that your product meets all the relevant legal requirements without needing to contact you directly.

These measures help ensure accountability and make it easier to respond to issues like recalls, updates, or security incidents involving specific product versions.
area-1.ARP1.questions.Q1.text: Does your product carry a visible and unique identifier like a type, batch, or serial number—or if that’s not possible, is this information clearly included in packaging or accompanying documentation?
area-1.ARP1.questions.Q2.text: Do you keep the product’s technical documentation and the EU Declaration of Conformity available for at least 10 years after it's placed on the market (or longer if that's the product’s support period)?
area-1.ARP1.questions.Q3.text: Do you either provide a full EU Declaration of Conformity with the product, or—if you're providing a simplified version—include a direct link to where users can access the full version online?
area-1.ARP1.questions.Q4.text: Are the manufacturer’s contact details (postal address, email address, or other digital contact information) clearly provided on the product, packaging, or in the accompanying documentation?
area-1.ARP1.questions.Q5.text: Does the product with digital elements include instructions and information in accordance with Annex II, provided either in paper or electronic form?
area-1.ARP1.questions.Q6.text: Do the instructions remain clear, understandable, legible, and enable the safe use of the product?
area-1.ARP1.questions.Q7.text: Are the instructions and information stored and available for at least 10 years (or for the support period, if longer)?
area-1.ARP1.questions.Q8.text: Is the end date of support (at least month and year) clearly indicated in an easily accessible way at the time of purchase, and, where applicable, on the product with digital elements, its packaging, or provided digitally?”
